artboards.title: Library Statistics — USB Stick Performance (this stick)
What each player generation does to a stick

annotations.text: Verdict thresholds are provisional (see the design note). They need one known-bad stick and one known-good stick to calibrate before shipping. The slow-stick numbers on the right are invented to show the states; the numbers on the left were measured on WHALESHARK2 today, read-only.

Open decision: the old comparative score is gone; history rows show the three raw numbers and the overall verdict instead. Keep the score column in the history table if you want the old ranking back, otherwise the table gets recreated (pre-1.0).

Player rows are grouped by the database they read, not by model year. Tags say where each claim comes from; sources are listed at the end of the design note. Manufacturer pages state a USB version for only four devices, so 'assumed USB 2.0' is exactly that.
